# UIT-VSMEC manual drop

Place the license-compliant official UIT-VSMEC test file at `data/external/manual_drop/uit_vsmec/test.csv`.
The normalized file must be `data/processed/external/uit_vsmec/test.csv` with columns `sample_id,text,emotion`.
Provide the official source URL/revision, license/access note, split evidence, and SHA-256 in `data/manifests/external_datasets.json`.
Do not substitute an unsplit mirror or a random split.
